CustomField.description: Start of the current rolling-24-hour publication-count window (design §6.6). ContentPublicationBudget rolls Publication_Count__c back to 0 and resets this to the current time when it is found to be more than 24 hours old.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by ContentPublicationBudget on first use and on every window rollover. Do not edit manually except to force an early rollover.
CustomField.label: Window Start
